## Coaching Points

- Maintain proper body lean and posture throughout each task
- Enforce appropriate rest intervals throughout the drill

*NOTE: One repetition includes sprinting in place, sprinting 10 yards, jogging 10 yards followed immediately by sprinting 10 yards (an area with 50 - 60 yards of flat running surface is needed)

## 9. Flying 30s

Exercise Objective: Develop appropriate stride length and stride frequency

## Procedure

1. Begin jogging at half speed, increasing speed with each stride for the first 30 yards so maximal velocity is attained by the 30-yard mark (-20)
2. Continue to sprint at maximum velocity for 30 yards before decelerating gradually
